mapper.sql: select order_id, member_id, kind, item_id, title, spec, amount_cents, status, thumb, create_time from hys_order
mapper.select: select count(*) from hys_order where create_time like concat(#{day}, '%')
mapper.insert: insert into hys_order (order_id, member_id, kind, item_id, title, spec, amount_cents, status, thumb, create_time) values (#{orderId}, #{memberId}, #{kind}, #{itemId}, #{title}, #{spec}, #{amountCents}, #{status}, #{thumb}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: update hys_order set status = #{status} where order_id = #{orderId}
